cli.finalMessage:
This looks complete. The screen at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` builds an "Edit profile" form entirely from Strata components (Card, Avatar, FileUpload, TextField, DatePicker, Select, Button, Badge, Toast), with mock starting data for a photo, full name, email, phone, date of birth and preferred language. Each field's label shows a "Changed" status badge when its draft value differs from the last-saved value; Cancel and Save are disabled until something changes, Cancel reverts the draft, and Save commits it and shows a success toast ("Profile updated"). Styling uses only `--strata-*` tokens and logical CSS properties, and `audit_snippet` scored both files 100 with no findings.

One thing worth flagging: I followed Strata's own docs examples (`date-picker-invalid`, `date-picker-range`) in importing `parseDate`/`today`/`getLocalTimeZone`/`CalendarDate` from `@internationalized/date`, which isn't a direct dependency in this app's `package.json` — since I couldn't run the app or a type-check (no `node_modules` present, and I was told not to touch `package.json`), I couldn't verify it resolves here.
